title: Two experimental regimes: 30B-A3B vs Next-80B-A3B
historical_commands_superseded: argine research trace ... on both models

protocol.kind: prospective; frozen before any EXP-026 measurement
protocol.primary_explanandum: delta_beta = beta_80b - beta_30b, beta = dln(gen_tok_s)/dln(budget/F) P1->P2, untraced, 4 generation threads; outcomes REPRODUCED / REVERSED / NOT DISTINGUISHED / NOT EVALUABLE

points.P3: secondary sub-F probe (not used for the primary beta)

explanandum.beta: beta_m = (ln s_P1 - ln s_P2) / (ln x_P1 - ln x_P2), s = gen tok/s (cell median of 3 VALID untraced launches at 4 generation threads), x = budget / F
explanandum.delta_beta: delta_beta = beta_80b - beta_30b (point value from the cell medians)
explanandum.envelope: for each model, beta is computed for every pairing of one P1 value with one P2 value (3 x 3 for performance cells, 2 x 2 for diagnostic cells); the envelope is [min, max] of those betas
explanandum.REPRODUCED: beta80 < beta30 and the envelopes do not overlap (max env80 < min env30)
explanandum.REVERSED: beta80 > beta30 and the envelopes do not overlap (min env80 > max env30)
explanandum.NOT EVALUABLE: a P1 or P2 primary cell of either model fails eligibility (fewer than 3 of 3 VALID)
explanandum.historical_direction: the 80B had the flatter speed/residency response (F-004: 0.384 vs 0.50-0.58)
explanandum.no_imported_thresholds: no pooled-SD threshold, no CV threshold, no p-value

gate.beta_traced: per model, from traced decode T (launch means) at P1 and P2: beta = (ln T_P2 - ln T_P1) / (ln x_P1 - ln x_P2); point from cell means, envelope over the 2 x 2 launch pairings
gate.FAIL: sign(delta_beta_traced) differs from sign(primary delta_beta), OR the traced envelopes overlap while the primary outcome is REPRODUCED or REVERSED
gate.NOT EVALUABLE: primary explanandum NOT EVALUABLE, or a P1/P2 diagnostic cell of either model not 2/2 eligible
gate.effect: if the gate is not PASS every candidate test is NOT EVALUABLE; the untraced performance result stands; traced results are never primary throughput results

a.premise: historical EWS-fraction metric (EWS90 routed experts / total routed experts) reported separately
a.endpoint: m = decode store-read bytes / eligible decode graphs / F per diagnostic launch; e_a = (ln m_P2 - ln m_P1) / (ln x_P2 - ln x_P1), envelope over the 2 x 2 launch pairings
a.UNRESOLVED_first: the 4 e_a values do not all have the same sign, or some m <= 0
a.SUPPORTED: max |e_a|80 < min |e_a|30 AND the M counterfactual moves beta80 toward beta30 at both bounds
a.UNRESOLVED: otherwise (80B smaller without overlap but the counterfactual does not move beta80 toward beta30 at both bounds)
a.NOT EVALUABLE: a P1/P2 diagnostic cell not 2/2 eligible, or the gate is not PASS
a.wording: consistent with routing concentration contributing to the regime difference

b.device: B_mix per model and round; comparison k: 80B at 2N vs 30B at N, N in {2, 4, 8}; favours 80B if min over rounds B_mix80 > max over rounds B_mix30, disfavours if max80 < min30, else indeterminate; device FAVOURS if all three favour, DISFAVOURS if all three disfavour, else INDETERMINATE
b.trace: q = E_r / M (bounded); at a point 80B LOWER if max(80B q_hi over eligible launches) < min(30B q_lo), HIGHER if min(80B q_lo) > max(30B q_hi), else indeterminate; trace LOWER/HIGHER if so at both P1 and P2, else INDETERMINATE
b.WEAKENED: (FAVOURS and trace INDETERMINATE) or (device INDETERMINATE and LOWER)
b.UNRESOLVED: device and trace contradict (FAVOURS+HIGHER or DISFAVOURS+LOWER), a relevant traced depth (P1/P2, both models) outside [2, 16], or any other evaluable combination
b.NOT EVALUABLE: required diagnostic cells not eligible, diskbench comparison incomplete, or gate not PASS
b.limitation: diskbench does not reproduce store asincrono behaviour; device evidence is device-level only

c.counters: whole-process store counters (commit/decommit/lock/read) are DIAGNOSTIC ONLY
c.FALSIFIED AS STATED: at BOTH P1 and P2, in BOTH eligible 80B diagnostic launches: E_nr_hi < E_r_lo
c.WEAKENED: the falsification condition holds at exactly one of P1, P2; OR at both P1 and P2 max over 80B launches of E_nr_hi / Res <= min over 30B launches of E_nr_lo / Res (the 80B is demonstrably not more non-read dominated than the 30B)
c.SUPPORTED: NOT REACHABLE with existing instrumentation (E_nr also contains barrier waits and hit lookups); no positive bookkeeping rule exists; inability to support (c) does not make it false
c.NOT EVALUABLE: required diagnostic cells not eligible or gate not PASS

d.endpoint: N / T per launch: non-residency (compute-inclusive) time share; never 'pure compute'; Gated DeltaNet itself is not isolated
d.SUPPORTED: at P1 AND P2: min(80B N/T) > max(30B N/T) AND the N counterfactual moves beta80 toward beta30
d.FALSIFIED AS STATED: at BOTH P1 and P2: max(80B N/T) < min(30B N/T)
d.NOT EVALUABLE: required diagnostic cells not eligible or gate not PASS

lifecycle_rules.SUPPORTED: explanandum REPRODUCED AND gate PASS AND at least one of (a), (b), (c), (d) SUPPORTED under its own frozen rule (others may be anything)
lifecycle_rules.FALSIFIED: explanandum REPRODUCED AND gate PASS AND all four candidates FALSIFIED AS STATED under their own rules; UNRESOLVED, WEAKENED or NOT EVALUABLE never count as falsified
lifecycle_rules.INCONCLUSIVE: every other case (explanandum NOT EVALUABLE, NOT DISTINGUISHED or REVERSED; gate failure; no supported candidate while at least one candidate is not falsified)

rq009_rules.ANSWERED: explanandum evaluable and all four candidates resolved (SUPPORTED, WEAKENED or FALSIFIED AS STATED)
rq009_rules.PARTIALLY ANSWERED: explanandum evaluable and at least one candidate resolved; the Unknown text is narrowed to the remaining candidates
rq009_rules.otherwise: RQ-009 remains PARTIALLY ANSWERED with a data note; it never regresses
rq009_rules.not_reproduced_note: the historical slope difference is not reproduced at matched budget/F; consistent with a normalization/region difference
rq009_rules.open_questions_edit: OPEN_QUESTIONS.md is not modified by the freeze; it is updated only at closure

traced_gate.reason: sign of delta_beta_traced differs from the primary delta_beta

rq009.note: the historical slope difference is not reproduced at matched budget/F; consistent with a normalization/region difference
